title: RTDBSCAN generic continuation improvement attempt closure
purpose: Close the Goal4731 RTDBSCAN generic continuation improvement attempt by binding it to existing Goal4670/4671 focused evidence instead of repeating no-go POD probes.
no_go_reason: Goal4671 telemetry shows root-link depth already about one link per root find in the best variant.
The dominant remaining work is candidate/root-find volume under the current grouped-union contract.
No new generic grouped-union algorithm exists in the current tree that plausibly changes that count structure.
Repeating RTDBSCAN micro-probes without a new algorithm would be churn.
reopen_condition: new generic grouped-union algorithm that reduces candidate/root work
new generic app-level contract that is not a DBSCAN identity kernel
frozen V2.14/V3 denominator and predeclared >=1.20x material-speed hypothesis

next_goal.title: choose one no-route/deferred app for fresh generic operator
next_goal.reason: RTDBSCAN cannot currently provide the second independent true V4 app-level win.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: close RTDBSCAN instead of rerunning the same no-go grouped-union lever
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. Repeating Goal4670/4671 would be foolish; closing RTDBSCAN based on the existing no-go evidence is the disciplined path.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: Spend another POD run on the same grouped-union lever without a new generic algorithm or frozen hypothesis.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Ignore Goal4671 and try to polish RTDBSCAN toward 1.20x, which would repeat the process-churn failure mode.
